name: Rokid Glass Browser
summary: Browse on RV101 with glasses controls or a phone web remote over Wi-Fi
description: A standalone browser for Rokid RV101 with on-glasses keyboard and touchpad navigation. Its optional web remote works in an Android or iOS browser on the same Wi-Fi network, offering a live HUD preview, text entry, scrolling, and cursor control without installing a phone companion. Gemini voice input and AI browsing tools require your own API key and internet access. The HUD preview is capped at about 5 fps and is intended for navigation rather than video playback.
author: xnohat

releases.notes: Python 3.13 run_python + pure-Python wheel install; sandboxed file/shell/git tools; camera and Gemini multimodal; full session history controls; AI console stays open until double-tap; ASR supports longer speech. FFmpeg/ImageMagick/Node are not shipped because RV101/YodaOS blocks their native execution/loading paths; no broken tool is advertised.

Camera vision (still/time-sampled), sandboxed file CRUD/download/media reading, full session-history management, and an allowlisted Android toybox run_shell tool confined to agent_workspace. Verified on-device: camera scene analysis, write/read text, download+understand a cat image, and pwd/ls shell commands.

Agent file tools in a private, sandboxed workspace on the glasses: list/read/write/delete/download. read_file understands text and media (images/audio/video via Gemini). Downloads are http/https only and size-capped; paths cannot escape the workspace. Tools now carry detailed usage + how-to-combine guidance. Verified: write+read a note, and download an image then read it ('a cat').
Multimodal honesty/safety fixes; verified see_page and watch_video on-device.

The AI agent can now SEE and HEAR via Gemini: see_page (understand images / on-screen content), watch_video (summarise the playing video — YouTube URLs go straight to Gemini's video understanding; other sites use captured frames + audio), and listen_audio (transcribe/describe sound). Verified: asking about a playing YouTube video returns a correct summary.
